headline: Treasury yields fall as investors crowd into bonds for safety amid election stock sell-off
detail: Money is fleeing riskier assets like stocks for bonds, signaling a defensive market mood. This directly pressures your tech-heavy, margin-fueled portfolio, suggesting continued downside risk.
rec: Review your most vulnerable leveraged positions like SOXL and MUU for potential trims to reduce overall portfolio risk.

headline: Midterm elections could jolt stocks as Democrats look poised to sweep Congress

headline: Super Micro’s stock pops as earnings show booming demand for AI servers
